scenes.title: Your gas bill
scenes.caption: What it says, and what to do.
scenes.say: Your Brightwater Energy gas bill has come. Here's what it says, and what to do about it.

scenes.title: The bill
scenes.caption: It covers 91 days of gas.
scenes.say: Brightwater Energy sent this bill for the three months up to the second of November, ninety one days in all.

scenes.title: The lines
scenes.caption: What makes up the total.
scenes.say: The gas came to two hundred and nineteen pounds, the standing charge to twenty nine, and VAT to twelve.

scenes.title: You owe
scenes.caption: You paid £180, so you owe £81.15.
scenes.say: You paid a hundred and eighty pounds by Direct Debit. The total was more, so you now owe eighty one pounds fifteen.

scenes.title: Direct Debit
scenes.caption: It rises to £87 a month from 1 December.
scenes.say: From the first of December, your Direct Debit goes up from sixty pounds to eighty seven, to cover the colder months.

scenes.title: Send a reading
scenes.caption: Send a real reading by 20 November.
scenes.say: The latest reading was only an estimate. Send a real one by the twentieth of November, and they'll correct the bill if needed.

scenes.title: Talk to them
scenes.caption: Finding it hard to pay? Talk to them.
scenes.say: If you're finding it hard to pay, talk to them. They can set up a payment plan, and you may get help too.

faults: scene 2: Brightwater is drawn as a bank (a pillared building), and a bank is not an energy company; the bill never visibly travels, since 'bill' is not a library thing, so only dots show
scene 4: Brightwater is a bank again; the picture also never shows the £180 already paid, only the debt
scene 5: Brightwater is a bank, and the pile of coins is far from showing a rise from £60 to £87; the 'You' person is a bare outline
scene 6: the cast has moved (Brightwater at far-right, the calendar and Reelie gone); the phone floats unused; the tick appears half cut off at the edge
scene 7: Brightwater is shown as a person in the same dark outline, in a different spot from scene 6; the whole reel should keep one cast and spots
